_ghi_chu: Chan doan nguyen nhan tung case truot, nhom viet sau khi doc log tho trong eval/logs/. Moi dong gan voi mot nhom nguyen nhan o muc duoi cung cua run_results.md.

nhom_nguyen_nhan.A: Ranh gioi need/check: nhom coi reply lac de hoac '+1' la KHONG ai dung toi (need); model coi co reply la da dung toi (check).
nhom_nguyen_nhan.B: Ngu canh lan hoi thoai khac: kenh dong, cua so +/-30 phut chua day tin cua cuoc noi chuyen khac, model tuong do la cau tra loi.
nhom_nguyen_nhan.C: nogrounding bi lan at: khi co bat ky tin tra loi nao o gan, model bo qua buoc 1 va khong con hoi 'can cu co nam trong tam quan sat khong'.
nhom_nguyen_nhan.D: Cua so thoi gian: cau tra loi den ngoai +/-30 phut thi khong bao gio vao ngu canh. Day la gioi han thiet ke, khong sua duoc bang prompt.
nhom_nguyen_nhan.E: Model doc sai du lieu da duoc cung cap (vi du bo qua truong sau_bao_phut).
nhom_nguyen_nhan.F: Ranh gioi san pham chua dinh nghia: dap an da co san trong kenh cho cau hoi giong het cua nguoi khac.
nhom_nguyen_nhan.G: Thieu nhan thu nam cho 'khong phai cau hoi can nguoi tra loi'.

GS-01.chan_doan: Cau hoi la 'rep tin nhan e voi a' — can cu nam trong tin nhan rieng, ngoai tam quan sat. Model mo ta dung ('chi la nhac nho mot nguoi khac tra loi') nhung van chon need. Buoc 1 chua du manh voi cau hoi tro ra ngoai Discord.
GS-01.huong_xu_ly: Them vi du 'nho rep tin nhan rieng' vao buoc 1 cua prompt.

GS-02.chan_doan: BOT tra loi sau 1 phut nen model ket luan done, bo qua viec cau hoi nhac toi 'file hay link' tu mot cuoc tro chuyen khong co trong ngu canh.
GS-02.huong_xu_ly: Buoc 1 phai chay truoc va doc lap voi viec co hay khong co tin tra loi gan.

GS-03.chan_doan: Ngu canh CO co 'co_anh_dinh_kem: true' nhung model khong dung no de kich hoat nogrounding. Luot 5 da tien tu done sang check, van chua dung.
GS-03.huong_xu_ly: Chuyen co anh dinh kem thanh luat cung trong code thay vi de model tu quyet.

GS-10.chan_doan: Cau hoi 'Han nop Lab02' trong kenh bot dong tin. Ngu canh day tin BOT tra loi nguoi khac ve deadline, model tuong da co huong dan.
GS-10.huong_xu_ly: Loc ngu canh theo chu de, hoac giam cua so o kenh co mat do tin cao.

GS-13.chan_doan: Co reply sau 3 phut nhung noi ve nhan role. Nhom coi lac de = khong ai dung toi = need; model coi co reply = check.
GS-13.huong_xu_ly: Chot lai dinh nghia trong spec §7 truoc CP4: reply lac de tinh la need hay check.

GS-14.chan_doan: Cau tra loi den sau 705 phut qua cau hoi 'ke' cua nguoi khac — nam ngoai moi cua so thoi gian hop ly.
GS-14.huong_xu_ly: Khong sua bang prompt. Can tim kiem theo ngu nghia thay vi theo thoi gian; de lai sau CP3.

GS-15.chan_doan: Luot 5 da them sau_bao_phut = 487 vao reply truc tiep, nhung model van viet 'trong vong 2 gio'. Day la loi tuan thu, khong phai thieu du lieu.
GS-15.huong_xu_ly: Tinh san co 'tra_loi_muon: true' trong code thay vi de model tu so sanh so.

GS-18.chan_doan: Khong ai tra loi; chi co chinh nguoi hoi nhan lai. Model tinh viec do la 'co nguoi dung toi'.
GS-18.huong_xu_ly: Noi ro trong prompt: tin cua chinh nguoi hoi khong tinh la co nguoi dung toi.

GS-20.chan_doan: Cau hoi giong het cua nguoi khac da duoc BOT tra loi 19 phut truoc trong cung kenh. Ca nhom va AI deu doc dung du lieu — khac nhau o dinh nghia san pham.
GS-20.huong_xu_ly: Nhom phai chot truoc CP4: xep need, check, hay them trang thai 'da co dap an, chi can tro'.

GS-23.chan_doan: Co tra loi nhung model danh gia la chua du ro nen ha xuong check. Bang chung mong, ranh gioi done/check con mo.
GS-23.huong_xu_ly: Bo sung tieu chi 'du de nguoi hoi di tiep' vao dinh nghia done.

GS-24.chan_doan: Tin la 'Kieu em ko co cau hoi nao hoi, co on ko a :))' — khong phai cau hoi can nguoi tra loi. Bon nhan hien tai khong co cho de xep.
GS-24.huong_xu_ly: Them nhan thu nam 'khong phai cau hoi', hoac quy uoc xep vao done kem ly do.
